impacts.description: Improved employability and career prospects of MSCA postdoctoral fellows within academia and beyond, driven by an increased set of research and transferable skills.
Increased and broadened research and innovation impact through enhanced networking and communication capacities with scientific peers and the general public.
Stronger R&I capacity and output among participating organisations and improved transfer of knowledge across the research system.
Increased global attractiveness, visibility and reputation of participating organisations.

Stimulated innovation and knowledge transfer and expanded cross-sectoral career opportunities for researchers, through the non-academic placement incentive promoting career moves between sectors and organisations.
Spread of excellence and fostering of balanced brain circulation in widening countries, via ERA Fellowships implemented through Work Programme Annex 11.
